hypothesis: Showing trip-planning stress before a real TICT trip plan makes the product benefit immediately understandable.

visual_intent.setting: a bright international airport departure hall
visual_intent.subject_action: a solo traveller switches between several planning tabs on a phone and visibly feels overwhelmed
visual_intent.camera: natural handheld push-in, authentic travel-ad cinematography

base.intent: overwhelmed solo traveller planning on phone in airport

scenes.voiceover: Planning a trip should not feel like another job.

visual_intent.subject_action: the approved trip overview screen moves into view and remains legible
visual_intent.camera: slow controlled push toward the exact application capture

scenes.voiceover: TICT turns every booking, place, and next step into one clear trip plan.

visual_intent.setting: a deterministic TICT brand end card
visual_intent.subject_action: the approved mascot and logo appear beside one call to action
visual_intent.camera: static end card with a subtle local push-in

scenes.voiceover: Plan less. Travel more with TICT.
